leftEvidence.title: The feared fate is reversed across the generations

points.label: Event action and claim
points.left: The LORD answers the assembly’s words: adults numbered from twenty upward will fall in the wilderness except Caleb and Joshua.
points.right: The journey from Kadesh Barnea to the brook Zered takes thirty-eight years, until the men of war perish from the camp.

points.label: Response and consequence
points.left: The children feared as prey will enter; the people will bear wandering forty years, one year for each day of spying.
points.right: The LORD’s hand is described as being against them until they are consumed.

payload.posture: Numbers relates forty spying days to forty wilderness years; Deuteronomy measures thirty-eight years from Kadesh Barnea to Zered.

rightEvidence.title: Thirty-eight years pass until the fighting generation is gone

payload.tension: The passages use different endpoints and purposes, but neither supplies a complete arithmetic reconciliation.
payload.title: Forty years and thirty-eight years
